messages:
noah reyes: morning! started yesterday, thanks for the warm welcome. quick cloud access ask: I need to run load tests in eu-west1 and create a small sandbox project. also need to call internal embeddings service. who should own the billing link and who handles AWS assume-role for eu accounts?

tara singh: hi noah, welcome :wave: Finance owns the eu billing (redwood-eu-sandbox). We usually create a sandbox project and link billing rather than adding people to the org billing account. Dev-access team handles the AWS cross-account role.

noah reyes: great — can you/they create the project and give me compute & sa permissions? i'll need to run gcloud and deploy a tiny vm.

dev-access: creating access request. Please confirm desired project id prefix (we'll append your initials). Also confirm if you need shared VPC attach.

noah reyes: use prefix redwood-sandbox-noah. I do not need to attach subnets to shared VPC for now; just outbound to internal embeddings endpoints is fine.

claire faye: tagging infra to give Project Owner-ish perms for quick setup: compute.admin + iam.serviceAccountUser + storage.admin (for logs). We'll limit to the sandbox proj. For embeddings calls you'll just need network egress; we'll whitelist the endpoints in the host project's firewall.

dev-access: Access request #AR-5332 created: Create project redwood-sandbox-noah-1782 under redwood-eu-sandbox billing; roles granted: compute.admin, iam.serviceAccountUser, storage.admin. AWS: grant assume-role on eu-dev-002 (arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/OrganizationAccountAccessRole). Approvers: infra, finance. ETA 1 business day.

noah reyes: awesome. once it's approved, could someone paste the minimal commands I should run to check access and assume the role?

tara singh: sure — after approval run:

```
# check gcp project
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-sandbox-noah-1782 --format=json

# assume aws role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/OrganizationAccountAccessRole --role-session-name noah-session
```

noah reyes: thanks! one more Q — do we have any EU-specific billing labels or tags required on sandbox projects?

claire faye: yes please add labels: env=sandbox, owner=noah.reyes, region=eu. Finance uses these for cost-allocation. We'll add them during project creation if you forget.

onboarding-bot: Welcome noah reyes! Don't forget to complete security training and repo access checklist within 7 days. :spiral_calendar:
